scope: Approved release-workflow signing and action-pin hardening
changes: Linux builds without injected updater signing keys and signs only the final repacked AppImage in a separate step.
Mac credentials scoped to its existing build/sign step; Windows retains its scoped build/sign step.
Default release token is read-only, draft job alone gets write, and Windows receives explicit signing secrets only.
Four release-chain workflows pin third-party actions to full commit IDs.
actionlint: passed using digest-verified1.7.12; external ShellCheck/Pyflakes disabled
limitations: Build-and-sign steps on Mac/Windows still trust build code; this is not an isolated signing service.
Pinned action code does not pin compiler channels or every downloaded tool.
Other findings from the broader audit are outside this release; no claim that all security issues are fixed.
Fresh native package/SDK validation required before publication.
